$comment: Regional land units. Values are from commercial converter sites found via web search on 2026-10-09; no state government source has been checked yet, so the file stays draft and the site hides these units. Before setting status to verified, a person must check each unit against the state's revenue department or land records and name themselves in verified_by. Bigha, biswa and katha are left out on purpose: their size changes from state to state and even district to district.
